name: Saddle sUSD metapool stale MetaSwapUtils library
summary: The sUSDv2 metapool was linked to a stale MetaSwapUtils whose _calculateSwap path omitted baseVirtualPrice scaling when saddleUSD-V2 was the input or output token. Repeated sUSD/saddleUSD-V2 round trips therefore shifted the invariant and price curve in the attacker's favor until both sides of the metapool were drained.
notes: This direct MetaSwap deployment hard-linked the stale MetaSwapUtils library 0x88cc4aa0; the link is immutable in the pool runtime, so the pool's deployment is the reset. Later fee and base-pool A changes only alter the loss size.
The saddleUSD-V2 drained from the metapool was redeemed at the base pool in the same transactions; it is counted as the DAI, USDC and USDT it redeemed for, not a second time as LP tokens.
BlockSec's front-run 0x9549c0cb (1,356.7 WETH) is an affiliated rescue: 1,356 WETH went to Saddle's multisig 0x3f8e527a in 0xe09b3017. It is neither the anchor nor in the campaign or loss.
